notes:
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
- Enterprise prospect (regulated healthcare + internal security review). They are evaluating LLM inference vendor for summarization + RAG inside provider-facing portal.
- Primary concern (beyond HIPAA/security): reliability comms. Direct quote from call: “We can tolerate partial degradation if we can see what’s impacted fast and route around it. What we can’t tolerate is vague status updates.”

FIRMOGRAPHICS / CONTEXT
- Northbridge Health Systems (NHS) runs a multi-tenant provider portal + internal operations tooling.
- Workloads:
  - Summarization: clinician note summarization (async + some interactive)
  - RAG/doc search: internal policy + knowledge base search
  - Chat: provider portal assistant
- Traffic profile (early estimates): 30–60 req/s peak for chat endpoints during business hours; embeddings batch jobs nightly.

REQUIREMENTS (INFERENCE)
- Latency targets:
  - chat: p95 < 1.5s first token, p95 < 15s for 500 tokens (streaming heavily used)
  - embeddings: throughput-oriented, can batch; nightly job windows
- Model preferences: open models acceptable if quality stable; wants ability to pin model version + structured rollouts (canary).
- Routing/fallback: must support fallback model and region failover policy (they will implement client-side fallback if we provide clear status signals).

REQUIREMENTS (RELIABILITY / INCIDENT COMMS)  — KEY THEME
- Status page granularity request:
  - They do NOT want a single “API Degraded” component for everything.
  - Asked for separate visibility for Streaming vs non-streaming failures; plus embeddings being separate from chat.
  - Wants region-specific indicators (at least us-east/us-west; EU optional but “nice to have” for future).
- Incident update cadence expectations:
  - “First update within 10–15 minutes for any customer-impacting event.”
  - Follow-ups every ~30 minutes for Sev1 until mitigation is in place; OK with “next update at <time>” even if uncertain.
- Post-incident summary:
  - Requested customer-facing post-incident summary for Sev1+ within 3 business days.
  - Wants: impact window, what was impacted (component-level), mitigation taken, and prevention actions.
  - Explicitly said they understand we won’t publish sensitive details; they want a consistent format and on-time delivery.

SECURITY / COMPLIANCE NOTES
- Deployment preference: VPC/private control plane strongly preferred for PHI-adjacent workloads. They asked whether Dedicated can meet isolation needs; they will decide after security review.
- Required controls: SSO/SAML for console, audit logs, KMS integration, retention controls (log retention + ability to request deletion), and data residency roadmap.
